newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan stocks surge on new accounts buying.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan stocks surge on new accounts buying.

text.p: Pakistani stocks soared 2.44 percent on Tuesday amid new accounts buying spurred by foreign interest in select blue chips, dealers said.
"The buying interest in some of the expensive blue chips indicates the presence of overseas buying," dealer Ali Raza Mooney of KAB Securities said.
He said the turnaround of the index after Monday's plunge showed a new found underlying strenght of the market.
The Karachi Stock Exchange (KSE) 100-share index rose 41.47 points to end at 1,743.53. Gainers led losers 199 to 134. Turnover fell to 50 million shares from Monday's 55 million.
